app.title: Tower Defense
app.tagline: Build mazes, hold the line, survive every wave.

howToPlay.title: How to play
howToPlay.build: Pick a tower (or press 1-9) and click the grass to build it. Creeps follow the road, and nothing can be built on it.
howToPlay.path: Build along the bends of the road: a tower that covers two stretches shoots twice as often.
howToPlay.upgrade: Click a tower to upgrade or sell it. Kills and income earn gold.
howToPlay.waves: Press N to call the next wave early. Lose all your lives and the game is over.

lobby.comingSoon: The PvP lobby arrives in phase 3.
